title: Pick a color from anything on screen.
notes: Pick a color from anything on screen: ⌃⌥P (Ctrl+Alt+P on Windows) puts a loupe on the pointer over every screen; click a pixel and its hex code (like #AE4E4A) is on your clipboard, without opening Rega. The shortcut can be changed in Settings › Shortcuts. It's also on Rega's home screen, its toolbar and the menu bar.
